purpose: Show actual filter operations on saved R6b right-wrist samples; no new accuracy claim.
scientific_source: Thesis V9 Section 2.5, Appendix F; exact saved filter metadata.

parameters.fs: derive from median recorded time_s differences

timing.status: Editorial; motion does not measure pipeline time.

render.format_note: Final 1440x1080 4:3 panel beside recorded context, under D-028; supersedes the initial full-slide width.

assets.name: filter_hampel
stages: Flag the spike using the implemented two-rolling-median scale
Remove flagged sample; leave a gap
assets.qualification: The test flags a sample; it does not itself replace it by the median.

assets.name: filter_gap
assets.qualification: Interior gap only; this is modelled input, not a new sensor observation.

assets.name: filter_butterworth
assets.qualification: Full contiguous valid run is used before cropping; the backward pass needs future samples. The passing cursor is explanatory, not a recording of runtime.

assets.name: filter_one_euro
stages: Reveal received samples and causal output
assets.qualification: Use Appendix-F minimum 0.05 Hz and beta 1.0, not the unrelated V2 CLI default of 1.0 Hz. No zero-lag claim.

assets.name: filter_savgol
stages: Show the quadratic fit and centre output
assets.qualification: Isolated candidate demonstration on raw recorded depth, not the complete despike-gap-smooth chain.

assets.name: filter_median
assets.qualification: Isolated candidate demonstration; a high isolated sample is rejected rather than averaged.

processing_scope: Run imported frozen helper functions read-only on pinned arrays. Do not run main(), overwrite experiments or present comparison traces as new measurements. For smoother-only candidate demonstrations, apply to raw contiguous valid runs consistently and label this scope in notes/report. Do not connect plotted gaps.
outputs: Each name.gif, .mp4 and .png in media/. Full provenance and numerical/decoding checks in review/FILTER_DEMO_CHECK.json.
display: Large title, one short phase sentence, large axes, and compact Recorded input / Filter output legend. No four-panel comparison in the main talk. Large dots/window only when that operation is being explained.
